name: measure_zero_terminated_string
description: Walks forward one byte at a time until it reaches a zero byte, then returns the number of bytes before that terminator. It does not write to memory.

name: compare_byte_strings_bounded
description: Compares two byte strings position by position for at most about 32 thousand bytes, returning -1 when the first differing byte is smaller, 1 when it is larger, and 0 when the strings match through the terminator.

name: copy_block_overlap_safe
description: Copies a block of bytes from source to destination, copying forward when the destination is at or below the source and backward otherwise, so overlapping regions are copied correctly.

name: initialize_globals_open_library
description: Clears a run of 4-byte global storage, saves the exec base pointer in a global slot, and opens the library named in the referenced text dos.library. It raises an alert through the exec base if opening fails and otherwise runs the routine that follows.

name: stub_return_only
description: Does nothing: the body is a single return with no reads, writes or calls.

name: split_quoted_fields_in_buffer
description: Copies a zero-terminated source string into a buffer obtained from the allocation call, then splits it into fields: whitespace ends an unquoted field, and double quotes group a field in which a doubled quote stands for one quote character. Each finished field is terminated with a zero byte.

name: append_string_bounded
description: Finds the terminating zero of the first string and copies the second string after it, stopping at about 32 thousand bytes and adding a terminator if the copy was cut short. It returns the destination pointer.

name: append_string_with_count_limit
description: Finds the end of the destination string, then copies source bytes after it until the zero terminator is copied or the count argument runs out. If the count ran out, it writes a zero terminator after the last byte copied and returns the destination pointer.

name: copy_string_pad_with_zeros
description: Copies at most the given number of bytes from the source string into the destination, stopping after the source terminator, and then fills the rest of the count with zero bytes. It returns the destination pointer.

name: fetch_window_icon_entry
description: Opens a library handle from the global block, follows pointers from the argument record through two lookups to an entry, and stores that entry's data and a second value into the argument record. It then releases the handle, and the referenced text names the window and icon.library.

name: format_into_buffer_and_terminate
description: Stores the output buffer pointer in a global slot, runs the formatting routine on the stack arguments, writes a zero terminator at the current output position, and returns the formatter's 32-bit result.

name: format_into_buffer_short_result
description: Stores the output buffer pointer in a global slot, runs the formatting routine on the stack arguments, writes a zero terminator at the output position, and returns the formatter's result as a 16-bit value.

name: emit_byte_to_output
description: Writes the low byte of its argument at the current position of the output pointer kept in a global slot, advances that pointer by one, and returns the byte.

name: inspect_undecompiled_runtime_entry
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code exists for this routine. The facts show a single call from the surrounding code, 48 instructions and two calls to other routines, and nothing more can be said from them.

name: format_text_via_callback

name: signed_divide_with_sign_fixup
description: Notes whether exactly one of the two operands is negative, calls the division routine, negates its result when that flag is set, and returns that result paired with the second operand.

name: call_and_return_register_pair

name: forward_single_call_return

name: call_optional_slot_then_routine

name: release_recorded_resources

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:109A
name: wait_and_set_blitter_registers
description: Waits for the blitter, then writes its first and last word masks, its modulo registers and its C data register with fixed values, and sets a DMA control value with the enable bit.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:10C4
name: update_sector_flag_byte
description: Calls two other routines, then sets the top bit of the byte at the address register when the byte before it has its low bit clear, unless bit 6 is already set; when that low bit is set it clears the top bit instead.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:10D2
name: update_flag_byte_top_bit
description: Sets the top bit of the byte at the address register when the byte before it has its low bit clear, unless bit 6 is already set; when that low bit is set it clears the top bit instead. It calls no other routines.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:10E8
name: clear_top_bit_store_byte
description: Stores the low byte of the data register into the byte at the address register with its top bit cleared.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:111C
name: start_disk_read_with_sync
description: Writes the disk sync register with the standard sync constant, sets the disk pointer to the address register, and writes the disk length register with the enable bit set from the argument, along with the ADKCON and DMA control registers.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:115A
name: wait_for_disk_interrupt_flag
description: Returns zero at once when a flag bit in the structure is set. Otherwise it calls another routine once and returns minus one, and in both cases it writes two control words to the disk length and interrupt-request registers.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:117E
name: clear_disk_length_and_interrupt
description: Writes two control words to the disk length and interrupt-request registers, the registers the facts list as touched.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:1192
name: set_adkcon_unit_bit
description: Writes a control word to the ADKCON register, then, when a signed word in the frame is negative, writes a CIA port bit selected by a counter from the frame plus three.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:11A2
name: set_drive_control_bit
description: Computes a bit position from a frame word plus three and writes the data register value with that bit forced to one to the CIA port B register.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:11C0
name: set_cia_port_all_bits
description: Writes all ones to the CIA port B register and then calls two other routines.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:11DA
name: step_to_table_position
description: Reads a 16-bit entry from a table indexed by a frame word, compares its upper bits with those of the argument, and calls another routine once for each step of the difference.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:122E
name: wait_for_disk_status_bit
description: Polls the CIA port A status bit for up to eighty-six passes, calling another routine between polls. When the bit is clear it zeroes the table entry selected by a frame word and returns zero; if every poll fails it returns error code 30.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:124E
name: clear_table_entry_by_index
description: Clears the 16-bit entry of the global table selected by an index word in the frame and returns zero.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:1264
name: set_cia_port_direction_bits
description: Reads a value from another routine, clears bit 1 when the second argument is non-negative, forces bit 0 on, writes the result to the CIA port B register, and then calls another routine.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:128E
name: write_cia_port_b_value
description: Writes the value returned by another routine to the CIA port B register.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:129A
name: compute_cia_port_mask
description: Builds a bit mask from a frame byte plus three and the current CIA port value, clears bit 2 when a table entry's bit 0 is set, and returns the result with the second argument in the low longword.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:12CE
name: poll_cia_timer_until_clear
description: Calls another routine repeatedly, polling the CIA timer control bit 0 until it clears each time, and repeats until the routine returns one, then returns zero.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:12E2
name: start_cia_timer_when_idle
description: When the CIA timer control bit 0 is clear and the argument is not one, writes three timer control values in sequence to the CIA timer registers.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY][a](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:12F0
name: write_cia_timer_setup_values
description: Writes three fixed timer values in sequence to the CIA timer registers, the registers the facts list as touched.

name: stub_return_only
description: Does nothing: the body is a single return with no reads, writes or calls.

name: store_row_address_pointer_words
description: Computes a row address from the low nibble of a frame word times 160 bytes plus a base pointer, then stores that address and four addresses spaced 40 bytes apart into a block of 16-bit pointer words.

name: reset_hardware_and_start_copper
description: Clears the colour registers, then writes the CIA interrupt control, interrupt, DMA and copper-list registers to set up the custom chips, and the facts show COP1LCH, COPJMP1, INTENA and POTGO among the registers touched.

name: swap_pair_then_call
description: Clears a third longword of the structure, swaps its first two longwords, and calls two other routines.

name: poll_input_port_samples
description: Sets a control bit in its first argument and adjusts a word at a fixed offset, writes a value into a global control slot, and stores two sampled bytes with their top bits set when the matching global bit is clear. It increments a counter and calls another routine that may call a hook stored in a slot.

name: read_joystick_mouse_ports
description: Samples the port state through the CIA and the joystick data registers: it stores two bytes with their top bits set according to global flag bits, increments a sample counter, calls an optional hook from a slot, and calls two more routines.

name: advance_timed_sequence_step
description: Advances a timed step counter while a flag bit is set, reloading it from a stored value when it runs out. When a second counter runs out it clears the flag bit or moves to the next step, and it calls another routine.

name: spread_bytes_every_other_byte
description: Copies a run of bytes from the source pointer into every other byte of the destination, starting at offset two, for the count given in the first argument.

name: initialize_sequence_state
description: Stores a source pointer, a destination pointer two bytes past the given base, and count values into a state block, clears the step counter, and sets the countdown to fifteen with a flag of one.

name: return_flag_bit_zero
description: Returns bit 0 of a flag word held in a global slot, as zero or one.

name: busy_wait_on_memory_value
description: Busy-waits on a value at a fixed offset from the address register and then returns the data register unchanged.

name: repack_argument_bits_masked
description: Repacks bits from two argument words using fixed bit masks, mixing low bits of the first word into a result word, and returns a combined longword.

name: store_position_with_offset_pair
description: Adds two offsets to the first two words at the address register and stores them as position values. When the flag argument is non-zero it also stores sums using the words at offsets 8 and 10 bytes; otherwise it stores a fixed value of minus 32.

name: clear_position_fields_if_flagged
description: When bit 4 of a global flag byte is set, stores minus 32 into two fields of the frame structure, then calls two other routines and returns the two input registers as a pair.

name: fill_four_row_bytes_pattern
description: Writes a constant byte into four separate buffers, then writes values derived from the two arguments into one row of each buffer, with each buffer receiving its own variant.

name: start_copper_list_and_wait
description: Calls another routine until its result is zero, clears a field in the structure, writes the copper list pointer and the copper jump strobe, and returns the saved value.

name: advance_counter_wrap_at_ten
description: Calls another routine and, when a masked field is zero, increments a global counter, resetting it to one when it exceeds ten.

name: copy_tile_rows_to_lanes
description: Copies 22 rows of four words from a source table into a destination, writing four interleaved word lanes spaced ten words apart, with the destination start computed from a row and column argument.

name: cycle_index_one_to_six
description: Counts a delay down and, when it reaches zero, cycles a stored index from one to six each time a masked flag word is set, returning the masked flag word.

name: update_entry_from_table_index
description: Returns its inputs unchanged when either of two stored fields is zero. Otherwise it indexes a table by the first argument, updates a stored index, and calls two other routines.

name: dispatch_table_or_copy_fields
description: When a state word is zero it calls the routine selected by a table entry indexed from another state word and returns its result. Otherwise it copies two state fields and returns the first argument.

name: copy_two_state_fields
description: Copies two longword fields of the state structure from offsets 60 and 64 to offsets 68 and 72.

name: clamp_and_align_position_fields
description: Computes a position from two state fields, clamps it against a limit that depends on another field, and masks it to multiples of sixteen before storing.

name: reset_timer_state_fields
description: Sets a countdown field in the state structure to fifty and clears two counter fields.

name: advance_timed_animation_state
description: When a state word is non-zero it advances a counter, and when that counter reaches the limit stored in a field it resets the counter and updates a status byte, calling two other routines.

name: check_counter_and_reset_state
description: Calls another routine while a counter field is below forty-eight, then resets two state fields when a status byte holds the value minus 103.

name: initialize_state_fields_block
description: Clears three bytes of state, calls another routine, sets a status word to one, clears several fields, and copies one field into a countdown.

name: find_table_entry_containing_point
description: Walks a table of 144-byte records, comparing a point formed from the two arguments and two state offsets with each record's bounds, and stops at the first record whose bounds contain it.

name: read_tile_nibble_at_position
description: Converts two position arguments to tile coordinates by dividing by sixteen, looks up a row offset in a table, and returns the low nibble of the byte there, or zero when its five-bit field exceeds nine.

name: allocate_free_list_slot
description: Scans a list of 36-byte entries for one whose first longword is zero and bit 1 is clear, returning minus one when none is free within the count. Otherwise it fills that entry with the arguments and stored template values.

name: process_flagged_record_tables
description: Clears a state field, then walks two tables of 144-byte records, calling another routine for each record whose flag bit is set. The second table is walked only when a state word is zero.

name: process_flagged_fixed_table
description: Walks a fixed table of 144-byte records, calling another routine for each record whose flag bit is set.

name: test_entry_outside_window
description: Tests an entry's flag and its position against a window derived from two state fields, and calls another routine when the entry lies outside that window and its flags allow it.

name: update_entry_flags_and_list
description: Stores a value in the entry's twelfth longword, copies its flags with bit 19 cleared, and when bit 3 is set walks a list of words that ends at a negative value, updating the flags for each value.

name: process_visible_entries_table_a
description: When a status word is zero and a flag word has bit 14 set, walks sixteen table entries of 144 bytes, checks each active entry's bounds against the stored position values, and calls another routine for each match.

name: process_visible_entries_table_b
description: When a status word is zero and a flag word has bit 14 set, walks eight table entries of 144 bytes, checks each active entry's bounds against the stored position values, and calls another routine for each match.

name: process_entries_flag_bit_15
description: When a status word is non-zero and bit 15 of a flag word is set, walks eight table entries and calls another routine for each entry whose flag and bounds match the saved position values.

name: match_entry_against_table
description: When the given entry is active and its flag bit is set, copies four of its position fields and walks eight table entries, calling another routine for each entry whose bounds overlap them.

name: process_active_table_entries
description: Walks eight table entries whose active flag is set, computes a value from each entry's position fields, and calls another routine with it.

name: process_active_entries_if_idle
description: Returns at once when a state word is non-zero; otherwise it walks eight active table entries and processes each one through another routine.

name: process_entries_table_c
description: When a status word is zero and flag bit 8 is set, walks twenty table entries whose flag bit 0 is set and calls another routine for each entry that lies within the stored position window.

name: process_entries_table_d
description: When a status word is zero and flag bit 10 is set, walks ten entries whose flag bit 2 is set and calls another routine for each one inside the stored window.

name: clear_flags_process_table_e
description: Clears two state words and flag bit 13, and when bit 11 was set and flags remain, walks sixteen entries whose bit 3 is set and calls another routine for each one within the stored window.

name: scan_entries_within_offset_window
description: Walks a list of position records, testing each record whose first flag is set against a window whose origin is set by two arguments, and returns the result of that scan.

name: process_records_within_window
description: Walks a list of position records and, for each record whose flag is set and whose position lies in a window with its origin at two arguments, sets a fixed value into a slot and calls another routine with the record index.

name: clear_and_fill_display_rows
description: Clears a block of 1280 longwords at a fixed address, then copies rows of values from four source tables into interleaved positions of that block, and calls three other routines.

name: update_status_and_draw_digits
description: Calls routines to update a status display, selects one of several actions from flag fields, then walks the nibbles of a longword field and passes each digit after the first non-zero one to another routine.

name: print_nibbles_skip_leading_zeros
description: Walks the nibbles of a longword field from the most significant end, skipping leading zero nibbles, and passes each remaining nibble to another routine. It calls one more routine at the end.

name: print_nibble_digits_after_setup
description: Calls two routines, then walks the nibbles of a longword field from the most significant end, skipping leading zero nibbles and passing each remaining one to another routine.

name: clear_entry_display_blocks
description: Calls another routine and, when a state word is non-zero, clears a run of 16-bit display entries and calls further routines to fill them.

name: copy_pattern_table_block
description: Copies a fixed set of longwords from a source table into fixed destination slots, one pair of longwords per assignment.

name: store_value_into_fixed_slots
description: Stores its argument into a fixed set of longword slots and sets the paired 16-bit slot from the low word of the first slot.

name: copy_table_row_to_slots
description: Copies longword values from a table row chosen by the argument, with the row offset shifted left by six, into the target block at fixed intervals.

name: copy_row_selected_by_field
description: Chooses row eleven or ten by comparing a state field against half of another field, then copies the same longword pattern as its sibling into the target block and calls another routine.

name: copy_table_column_to_slots
description: Calls four other routines, then copies a column of table values into the target block at the fixed intervals used by its sibling routines.

name: forward_two_calls_return
description: Calls two other routines in sequence and returns, with no other operations.

name: fill_fixed_slots_with_value
description: Writes its data-register argument into sixteen longword slots at fixed offsets from the address register.

name: run_frame_update_steps
description: Calls several routines in order, and calls two of them only when a state word is zero.

name: scan_entries_against_position
description: Walks entries whose flag bit 0 is set and compares their positions with two state fields, processing those that fall within the range.

name: initialize_object_record_from_table
description: Sets a fixed value into an object record and copies a value from a table indexed by a state field into it. The decompiler reported bad instruction data in this routine, so the later part of the body is unreliable.

name: initialize_object_fields_and_handler
description: Sets position, size and state fields of an object record to fixed values, stores the address of a handler routine in it, and sets or clears a flag bit according to two bits in the record's source byte.

name: initialize_object_fields_alt
description: Sets the same fixed position and size fields as its sibling routine, stores a handler address, and sets a flag word from bits in the record before calling another routine.

name: initialize_object_fields_short
description: Sets the same fixed fields as its sibling routines and then calls two other routines. The pseudo-code shows no further writes.

name: initialize_object_then_call_four
description: Sets the same fixed object fields as its sibling routines, then calls four other routines.

name: run_countdown_then_callback
description: Repeats a pair of calls and clears a field on each pass, decrements a countdown field, and when the countdown reaches zero it calls the function pointer stored in the record and returns.

name: run_countdown_then_callback
description: Repeats a pair of calls and clears a field on each pass, decrements a countdown field, and when the countdown reaches zero it calls the function pointer stored in the record and returns.

name: spin_setting_field_forever
description: Writes the largest signed 16-bit value into a field of the record and calls another routine, repeating this forever without returning.

name: spin_setting_field_forever
description: Writes the largest signed 16-bit value into a field of the record and calls four other routines, repeating this forever without returning.

name: run_countdown_then_callback
description: Repeats a pair of calls and clears a field on each pass, decrements a countdown field, and when the countdown reaches zero it calls the function pointer stored in the record and returns.

name: run_countdown_then_callback
description: Repeats a pair of calls and clears a field on each pass, decrements a countdown field, and when the countdown reaches zero it calls the function pointer stored in the record and returns.

name: run_state_machine_loop
description: Loops calling routines, clearing a flag bit in a status byte and writing a handler address into the record, and repeats until a routine returns non-zero, after which it updates the status byte and continues.

name: start_timed_sequence_on_flag
description: Sets a status bit and stores a handler address. When bit 1 of the status byte is set it writes a fixed negative value and the count 25 into the record and calls several routines.

name: run_countdown_sequence_with_offset
description: Writes a fixed negative value and the count 25 into the record, stores a handler address, and then runs a countdown loop that calls routines until the countdown reaches zero.

name: run_countdown_then_callback
description: Repeats a pair of calls and clears a field on each pass, decrements a countdown field, and when the countdown reaches zero it calls the function pointer stored in the record and returns.
